newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.18 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.18 pct lower.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange on Tuesday closed down 0.18 percent as most stocks followed a declining trend compared with the previous session, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 485.95 points, down from 486.83 points on Monday.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF dropped 0.5 dinar to 16.32 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia was down 0.46 dinar to 44. Palm Beach Hotels declined 0.2 dinar to 10.8 dinars.
The banking sector also followed the declining trend as Societe Tunisienne de Banque fell 0.49 dinar to 15.99 dinars. Banque de Tunisie edged lower 0.2 dinar to close at 76.4.
BIAT bank lost 0.16 dinar to 32.84 dinars.
Insurance firm ASTREE was up 0.74 dinar to 25.52 dinars. UBCI bank rose 0.7 dinar to 47.8.
The market total volume was 1.20 million dinars against 3.84 million dinars over the previous session.
